checks.outcome: Rotation is applied about the original subject before optional reflection using the original camera-to-subject plane; destination translation is composed afterward. Camera is translated without rotation/reflection. The noncommuting rotation-plus-mirror example is asserted against explicit coordinates in testRotationThenMirrorPreservesCameraAimsIdentityAndRoomContext.

The source is validated once before transformation and the completed scene once before return. No intermediate public transform is called by arranged. Existing source tests cover rotation or translation individually leaving bounds while the complete arrangement is valid, plus reflection returning a rotated intermediate to range.

LightingScene, StudioLight, Position, LightOptics, and ManualRoom are structs. arranged transforms a local scene and local light copies, then throws or returns the fully validated value. Existing tests assign only the returned value and assert the caller scene remains equal to the source for invalid final light, camera, explicit aim, and subject positions.

Mapping each existing light to a local copy preserves IDs/order and photometric settings. Explicit aim targets receive the same composition as light positions; nil aims remain nil and therefore follow the new subject. Camera lens, preview settings, and measured room remain copied; existing full-scene equality assertions cover these properties.

ManualRoom subjectX/subjectZ are room-relative placements. Room mapping subtracts scene.subject horizontally and adds those saved room offsets; preserving room settings during scene relocation is consistent with this definition. Vertical positions remain heights above the floor, so an arrangement height change moves the equipment relative to unchanged floor/ceiling measurements.

Nonfinite transform values reject before work; invalid source and unsupported schema reject before composition; mirror requires nonzero horizontal camera direction; final validation errors map to outsideSupportedScene. Tests exist for these cases, but were not executed.
